similarOrganizations.name: The Royal Society
similarOrganizations.description:
The Royal Society is the world's oldest scientific academy in continuous existence, and has been at the forefront of enquiry and discovery since its foundation in 1660.  

The backbone of the Society is its Fellowship of the most eminent scientists of the day, elected by peer review for life and entitled to use FRS after their name. There are currently more than 60 Nobel Laureates amongst the Society's approximately 1400 Fellows and Foreign Members.

Throughout its history, the Society has promoted excellence in science through its Fellowship and Foreign Membership, which has included Isaac Newton, Charles Darwin, Ernest Rutherford, Albert Einstein, Dorothy Hodgkin, Francis Crick, James Watson and Stephen Hawking.

The Society is independent of government, as it has been throughout its existence, by virtue of its Royal Charters. In 1663, The Royal Society of London for the Improvement of Natural Knowledge was granted its Arms and adopted the motto "Nullius in verba"​, an expression of its enduring commitment to empirical evidence as the basis of knowledge about the natural world.

The Society's activities include influencing science and education policy, funding leading researchers, publishing journals that span all the sciences and the history of science, and the provision of science communication activities for a variety of public audiences.

Founded in 2016 in Vancouver, Canada, Awakedata builds the application layer for industrial AI — the spatial logic, timing, state and workflow that turn a camera feed into an application a plant can rely on. In production since 2017.

Models and edge hardware are no longer the constraint. Turning a requirement into a working, verifiable application on a live site still is, because every use case is hand-built from scratch. That is the part we make configurable.

Studio — author and validate applications against real site footage. Morca, our application agent, drafts the logic from a plain-language requirement; your team inspects it, tests it against the cases that should and should not trigger, and releases it.

Edge — the on-site runtime, on NVIDIA Jetson, x86 GPU or other supported NPU. Video stays inside the plant; only detections and events leave.

Hub — multi-site deployment status, event streams and evidence, routed to the people who act.

Applications are expressed in SAIL, our industrial scene language and runtime, so they stay inspectable, testable against video and portable across hardware.

Partner-led delivery is our primary route to market. System integrators and consulting firms author and run applications on our platform, bringing their industrial knowledge rather than a fully staffed AI team, and keeping the client relationship.

What we deploy: complex SOP compliance — lockout/tagout and safe access to machinery, confined-space entry, GMP cleanroom intervention — alongside safety and PPE monitoring, quality inspection, and site operations such as vehicle, people and material flow. Applications run on existing plant cameras, with new ones added only where coverage is missing.

Deployed with global industrial enterprises across oil & gas, petrochemicals, manufacturing, food & beverage, pharmaceuticals, construction, ports and logistics.
